title: Corner C3 - Checklist Mode Visual Spec
summary: The workhorse mode. Per-agent draggable task list. Simple, fast, useful every day. Full design spec for Bobby.
content:
Corner C3: Checklist Mode Visual Spec

Steffen | 2026-03-16 For Bobby. This is the view clients use daily. It must be the simplest, most functional screen in Corner.

The Philosophy

Checklist mode is the anti-game. No pixel art, no isometric rooms, no RPG vibes. Just tasks. It's the mode Patrik's wife opens. It's the mode a CPA opens on their phone between meetings. "What's my team doing? What's next?" Answered in 2 seconds.

The design reference: Apple Reminders meets Linear. Clean, white-space-heavy, typography-driven. The information density is HIGH but the visual noise is LOW.

Desktop Layout (>= 1024px)

Overall Composition

+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [CORNER.]   [Game]  [CHECKLIST]  [Megaboard]                       [v]  |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                                                          |
|  +-------------------+  +--------------------------------------------+  |
|  | AGENT SELECTOR    |  |  TASK LIST                                 |  |
|  |                   |  |                                            |  |
|  | [o] Mom           |  |  [=] [x] Rebuild /v2 to audit standard    |  |
|  | [o] Bobby    *    |  |       ACTIVE  2h ago                      |  |
|  | [o] Steffen       |  |                                            |  |
|  | [o] Alex          |  |  [=] [ ] Fix shared nav footer Elmo bugs  |  |
|  | [o] Steve         |  |       QUEUED                               |  |
|  | [o] Cleo          |  |                                            |  |
|  | [o] Jacob         |  |  [=] [ ] Optimize room image sizes        |  |
|  | [o] Tony          |  |       QUEUED                               |  |
|  | [o] Elmo          |  |                                            |  |
|  | [o] Elon          |  |  ------- Done (3) -------                 |  |
|  | [o] Colton        |  |                                            |  |
|  | [o] Paige         |  |  [x] Ship /case-study page       1d ago  |  |
|  | [o] Pixel         |  |  [x] Fix /briefs accordion        2d ago  |  |
|  |                   |  |  [x] Deploy shared nav             3d ago  |  |
|  +-------------------+  |                                            |  |
|                          |  +--------------------------------------+  |  |
|                          |  | Add a task for Bobby...              |  |  |

+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Agent Selector (Left Sidebar)

Container:

  • Width: 220px fixed
  • Height: full viewport minus top bar (48px) and chat bar (56px)
  • Background: rgba(10, 15, 30, 0.5) (subtle, doesn't compete with task list)
  • Border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)
  • Padding: 16px 0
  • Overflow-y: auto (if many agents)

Section Label:

  • "AGENTS" at top
  • Font: JetBrains Mono 700, 9px, #6B7280, uppercase, letter-spacing: 0.15em
  • Padding: 0 16px
  • Margin-bottom: 12px

Agent Row (each agent):

  • Height: 40px
  • Padding: 0 16px
  • Display: flex, align-items: center, gap: 10px
  • Cursor: pointer
  • Transition: background 100ms ease

Agent Row - Default:

  • Background: transparent
  • Hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)

Agent Row - Selected:

  • Background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)
  • Border-left: 3px solid agentColor
  • Padding-left: 13px (16 - 3 border)

Agent Row Contents:

  • SpriteAvatar: 28px circle, agentColor border
  • Agent name: Space Grotesk 500, 14px, #F0ECE6
  • Status dot: 6px circle, far right, agentColor if active, #6B7280 if idle
    • Pulsing animation if active (scale 1.0 to 1.3, 1500ms)
  • Task count badge (optional): if agent has tasks, show count
    • Position: right side, before status dot
    • Font: JetBrains Mono 600, 9px
    • Color: agentColor
    • Background: agentColor at 10%
    • Padding: 1px 6px
    • Border-radius: 8px

"ALL" option at top:

  • First item in the list, before individual agents
  • Icon: grid/layout icon (Lucide Grid3X3 or similar), 16px, #6B7280
  • Label: "All Agents"
  • Shows aggregate task list across all agents when selected
  • Default selection on first load

Task List (Main Content Area)

Container:

  • Flex: 1 (fills remaining width)
  • Padding: 24px 32px
  • Background: transparent (inherits the dark background from the page)
  • Overflow-y: auto
  • Max-width: 720px (content doesn't stretch to full width on wide screens)
  • Margin: 0 auto (centered in the available space)

Agent Header (top of task list):

  • Only shown when a specific agent is selected (not "All Agents")
  • SpriteAvatar: 40px, agentColor border
  • Agent name: Space Grotesk 700, 20px, #FDF6EC
  • Agent role: Space Grotesk 400, 13px, #6B7280
  • Current status: status pill (same as HUD task cards)
    • ACTIVE: amber bg/text
    • IDLE: gray bg/text
    • DONE: green bg/text
    • BLOCKED: red bg/text
  • Margin-bottom: 24px

Task Item Card

The core component. Each task is a draggable card.

Card Container:

  • Min-height: 52px
  • Background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02)
  • Border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)
  • Border-radius: 8px
  • Padding: 12px 16px
  • Margin-bottom: 6px
  • Display: flex, align-items: flex-start, gap: 12px
  • Transition: background 100ms ease, border-color 100ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease

Card Hover:

  • Background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)
  • Border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)

Card While Dragging:

  • Background: rgba(10, 15, 30, 0.95)
  • Border-color: agentColor at 30%
  • Box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), 0 0 0 1px agentColor at 15%
  • Transform: scale(1.02) rotate(1deg) (slight tilt while dragging, playful)
  • z-index: 100
  • Cursor: grabbing

Card Contents (left to right):

  1. Drag Handle

    • Width: 16px
    • Icon: 6 dots (2 columns x 3 rows), each dot 2px, color #4A5568
    • Cursor: grab
    • Hover: dot color -> #6B7280
    • Only visible on hover over the card (hidden by default for cleanliness)
    • On touch devices: always visible

  2. Checkbox

    • Size: 18px square
    • Border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)
    • Border-radius: 4px
    • Background: transparent
    • Hover: border-color rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)
    • Checked: background agentColor, border-color agentColor
    • Check icon: Lucide Check, 12px, #FDF6EC (inside the checkbox)
    • Transition: all 200ms ease

    Check Animation:

    • On check: checkbox scales 1.0 -> 1.15 -> 1.0 (150ms spring)
    • Checkmark draws in with SVG stroke-dashoffset animation (200ms)
    • After 300ms: task text gets line-through and fades to 40% opacity
    • After 600ms: card slides down to "Done" section with 200ms ease-out

  3. Task Text

    • Font: Space Grotesk 400, 15px, #F0ECE6
    • Line-height: 1.45
    • Flex: 1
    • When done: text-decoration line-through, color #6B7280

  4. Status Pill (right side)

    • Same styling as HUD task card status badges
    • Font: JetBrains Mono 600, 9px, uppercase
    • Colors: ACTIVE amber, QUEUED gray, BLOCKED red, IN_PROGRESS amber
    • Padding: 2px 8px
    • Border-radius: 3px
    • Only shown for the TOP item (the active task). Others don't show a pill.

  5. Time Stamp (right side, below pill)

    • Font: Space Grotesk 400, 11px, #6B7280
    • "2h ago", "yesterday", etc.
    • Only shown on hover

Top Task Highlight: The first task in the list (position 0) is the "active" task. It gets special treatment:

  • Border-left: 3px solid agentColor
  • Status pill is always visible (not just on hover)
  • Background: agentColor at 3% (very subtle tint)
  • The agent is currently working on this task

Done Section

Divider:

  • Horizontal line: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)
  • Label in the center: "Done (N)" where N is the count
  • Font: JetBrains Mono 500, 10px, #6B7280, uppercase
  • Click to expand/collapse

Collapsed (Default):

  • Just the divider line with label
  • Small chevron icon (ChevronRight, 12px) that rotates 90deg when expanded

Expanded:

  • Completed task cards below the divider
  • Task text: line-through, color #6B7280
  • No drag handle (can't reorder completed tasks)
  • Checkbox is checked (agentColor fill)
  • "Completed at" timestamp shown: Space Grotesk 400, 10px, #6B7280
  • Show tasks from last 7 days only
  • Animation: section slides down (200ms ease-out), cards fade in (100ms stagger)

Empty State

When an agent has zero tasks:

Container:

  • Centered in the task list area
  • Padding: 80px 0

Content:

  • SpriteAvatar: 64px, agentColor border (large)
  • Agent name: Space Grotesk 600, 18px, #F0ECE6, margin-top: 16px
  • Message: "No tasks yet. Type one below."
  • Font: Space Grotesk 400, 14px, #6B7280
  • Margin-top: 8px

The empty state should feel inviting, not empty. The large sprite avatar gives it personality.

Add New Task Input

Position: Fixed at the bottom of the task list area, above the chat bar.

Container:

  • Padding: 12px 16px
  • Border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)
  • Background: rgba(10, 15, 30, 0.8)
  • Backdrop-filter: blur(8px)

Input Field:

  • Width: 100%
  • Height: 40px
  • Background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03)
  • Border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)
  • Border-radius: 8px
  • Padding: 0 16px
  • Font: Space Grotesk 400, 14px, #FDF6EC
  • Placeholder: "Add a task for [Agent Name]..." in rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)
  • Focus: border-color agentColor at 40%, background rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)

Submit Behavior:

  • Enter key submits the task
  • Task appears at the BOTTOM of the active list (not the top)
  • Input clears after submit
  • New task card slides in from below with 200ms ease-out animation

Mobile Layout (< 768px)

Agent Selector -> Horizontal Scroll

The sidebar becomes a horizontal scroll bar at the top of the content area.

Container:

  • Height: 56px
  • Width: 100%
  • Overflow-x: auto (horizontal scroll)
  • Scroll-snap-type: x mandatory
  • Background: rgba(10, 15, 30, 0.5)
  • Border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)
  • Padding: 8px 12px
  • Display: flex, gap: 8px
  • -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch

Agent Chip (each agent):

  • Display: flex, align-items: center, gap: 6px
  • Height: 40px
  • Padding: 0 12px
  • Background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03)
  • Border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)
  • Border-radius: 20px (pill shape)
  • Scroll-snap-align: start
  • White-space: nowrap
  • Flex-shrink: 0

Agent Chip Contents:

  • SpriteAvatar: 24px
  • Agent name: Space Grotesk 500, 12px, #F0ECE6
  • No status dot (save horizontal space)

Selected Chip:

  • Background: agentColor at 12%
  • Border-color: agentColor at 30%
  • Name color: agentColor

Task List on Mobile

  • Full width, no max-width constraint
  • Padding: 16px
  • Task cards fill the width
  • Drag-to-reorder works with touch (use @dnd-kit/sortable with touch sensors)
  • Drag handle: always visible on mobile (no hover state on touch)
  • Longer press (150ms) initiates drag

Add Task Input on Mobile

  • Same position (bottom, above chat bar and mode tab bar)
  • Input height: 44px (larger touch target)
  • Keyboard avoidance: input pushes up when keyboard opens (use visualViewport API or CSS env(keyboard-inset-height))

Tablet Layout (768-1023px)

Same as desktop but:

  • Agent selector width: 180px (narrower)
  • Task list max-width: 600px
  • Agent header sprite: 36px

Real-Time Sync Behavior

When a task is completed via WebSocket (agent finished work on the VM):

  1. The checkbox animates to checked state (200ms)
  2. Confetti particles burst from the checkbox (4-6 small circles in agentColor, spray upward and fade, 400ms total)
  3. Task text gets line-through
  4. After 1s: task slides to Done section
  5. Toast notification fires simultaneously

When a new task is created by the VM (agent self-assigns work):

  1. New card slides in at position 1 (below the current active task)
  2. Brief highlight pulse: background flashes agentColor at 8% then fades (300ms)

When drag reorder happens:

  1. Position updates write to Supabase immediately (optimistic update)
  2. If the user moves a task to position 0 (top), it becomes the new active task
  3. The VM picks up the priority change on next poll

Data Shape

Each task item:

{
  "id": "uuid",
  "automation_id": "bobby",
  "text": "Rebuild /v2 to audit standard",
  "status": "in_progress",
  "position": 0,
  "created_at": "2026-03-16T10:00:00Z",
  "completed_at": null
}

Status values: pending, in_progress, done, blocked Position: 0 = active task. Higher numbers = lower in the list.

Element Value

Card hover rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)

Status pill QUEUED bg rgba(107,114,128,0.15), text #6B7280

Typography Summary

Element Font Size Weight Color
Section label JetBrains Mono 9px 700 #6B7280
Agent name (sidebar) Space Grotesk 14px 500 #F0ECE6
Agent name (header) Space Grotesk 20px 700 #FDF6EC
Agent role Space Grotesk 13px 400 #6B7280
Task text Space Grotesk 15px 400 #F0ECE6
Status pill JetBrains Mono 9px 600 varies
Timestamp Space Grotesk 11px 400 #6B7280
Done count JetBrains Mono 10px 500 #6B7280
Input placeholder Space Grotesk 14px 400 rgba(255,255,255,0.25)

The Checklist is where work happens. No decoration. No distraction. Just tasks, status, and a big checkbox that feels satisfying to check. Bobby builds this in Step 4.
